newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dickson Concepts interim net up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Dickson Concepts interim net up sharply.

text.p: NOTE - Dickson Concepts is a wholesaler and retailer of brandname watches, garments, leather goods and jewellery.
The company proposed a special dividend of six H.K. cents per share vs nil.

Turnover represents sales less returns of own bought and concession goods. Due to the reclassification of turnover to include sales of concession goods in accordance with market practice, the comparative figure for 1995 has been adjusted from the previously published figure.
Net is after an exceptional gain on partial disposal of shares in Harvey Nichols Group plc.

Some 134.16 million bonus shares of HK$0.10 each were issued on September 12, 1996. The issued and unissued shares in the company were consolidated in the ratio of three shares of HK$0.10 each into one new consolidated share of HK$0.30 effective on September 13, 1996.

The calculation of share earnings is based on the weighted average of 269.41 million shares of HK$0.30 each vs 271.78 million shares of HK$0.30 each. Comparative share earnings has been adjusted to take into account the bonus issue and share consolidation.
